name: Ninpou — Power Rules
description: Medium range 10 m+2 m/Spirit; standard size 1 m/Spirit. Base damage/Hardness=used level+ceil(Spirit/2); standard DC 9+used level+ceil(Spirit/2). Learn one effect per bought power level, selecting it at that level or lower; one effect per action unless an explicit combination allows more. Cost usually equals used effect level; individual cards override. Additional purchases of the same power have level 1 free and use the highest power level for parameters. General Ninpou rules apply unless this element says otherwise. Effects listed here are options to learn, not automatic grants. Ordinary level, attribute, aptitude and equipment prerequisites still apply.

name: Cannon
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Single target

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common power range; instantaneous. Base damage 2 × power level used. From level 2, may use without chakra at half damage, including halved damage bonuses; this mode cannot combine benefits unless expressly allowed.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Create Weapon
description:
Action: Partial

Area / Target: Personal

Chakra cost: 1

No hand seals. Create simple/martial light, medium, long or throwing weapons, excluding Kage Fuuma, Straight Blade and Giant Fan. One use fills one equipment slot. Normal weapon prerequisites and proficiency still apply. Solid weapons are permanent; other weapons are sustained and vanish on leaving the hand. Gain elemental strengths/weaknesses and extra Hardness, but no elemental damage bonus. May Block projectile techniques. Level 6: heavy weapons and weapons for creatures larger than Medium.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Orb
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Single target

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range; instantaneous spherical projectile, diameter 0.5 m, standard power damage. Level 7: half chakra and cannot be Blocked, but receives no other effect, technique-aptitude or power benefits. This Advanced Guide revision supersedes the Basic Book Orb.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Ray / Beam
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: One or more targets

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range; instantaneous. Base damage 2 × power level. Cannot be Blocked except with a special weapon able to block techniques. Level 5: one ray per 2 power levels, one per target, targets at most 4 m apart. Level 8: full action for a stronger single-target ray with +2 base damage.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Restraint
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Circle

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range; continuous sticky/thick terrain slows creatures inside except those with Flight. Creatures already in the area get a defense; success still requires leaving on their next turn. Once per turn as a free action, Strength/Escape against standard DC suppresses Slowed until turn end; leaving prevents reapplication. Any area attack in the region removes the effect. Level 6: immobilized instead of slowed.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Barrier
description:
Action: Move

Area / Target: Wall or half-cylinder

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range; half common size and standard Hardness. Defensive Read Movement check at +2 accuracy, chakra paid before rolling. Cannot defend against an adjacent enemy where there is no room to place the barrier. Excess damage passes through a broken barrier; damaged unbroken objects lose 2 Hardness. Solid barriers permanent, others sustained. Level 6: hemispherical dome, or cage an enemy with standard action/Ranged Combat−2. Level 9: +2 Hardness.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Arrows
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: One or more targets

Chakra cost: Power level used; Feint 2

Common range; instantaneous. Create one projectile per used level, each with 2 base damage; concentrate or divide among targets. Each target defends once and gets damage bonuses only once. Feint mode deals no damage and uses Sleight of Hand instead of Agility to conceal the next ranged attack. Level 6: against one target that Dodges/Anticipates successfully, reroll attack against the same defense for half damage. Level 9: reroll damage is full.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Spear
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: One or more targets

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range and damage; instantaneous. A spike forms within 2 m and extends toward targets; divide damage among multiple targets. Ignore 3 Hardness of barriers/objects and 1 Body Hardness. Level 6: emerges below the target, ignores cover and prone defense bonuses, bypasses up to 2 Body Hardness. Level 9: target tests Readiness or becomes flat-footed; ignore all Hardness/Body Hardness. This Advanced Guide revision supersedes the Basic Book Spear.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Ricochet
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Chain of targets

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range and damage; instantaneous. Hit an initial target and up to one additional different target per 2 power levels, each within 10 m of the initial target. Choose order; the chain ends when any target defends successfully. Level 9: +1 base damage per new target hit, maximum+5.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Column
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Cylinder

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range and size; instantaneous; base damage 2 × used level. Level 7: divide the original area into 1 m-diameter columns, choosing affected locations within that original area. Level 10: these mini-columns force Readiness checks; failure weakens defense by−2.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Energize
description:
Action: Partial

Area / Target: Personal: limbs, weapon or projectile compartment

Chakra cost: 3

No hand seals; sustained. May replace weapon Strength/Dexterity damage attribute with Spirit. Weapon gains elemental advantages/weaknesses but not elemental damage/Hardness bonuses. Ambidexterity allows both weapons with one action but separate costs. Ends when a weapon is no longer wielded; launched projectiles expire at the end of the user’s turn. Allows Blocking projectile techniques and maneuver attacks. Can follow same-element Create Weapon as a free action. Cannot stack another melee-altering support technique or affect special weapons unless expressly allowed. Energized Iron Fist may use Spirit instead of Strength to determine its weapon damage, without Spirit bonuses.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.
shape: Personal: limbs, weapon or projectile compartment

name: Cloud
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Cone settling into a circle of twice common diameter

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range; concentration. At each living creature’s turn start, Vigor versus standard DC−2; failure takes fixed damage equal to used level and Slowed. User is immune; no contact between turns means no effect that turn. Imaginary Hardness equals standard Hardness and is eroded by explosive/wind area attacks, but does not reduce attack damage. Level 7: sustained. Level 10: +3 imaginary Hardness and double fixed damage.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.
shape: Cone settling into a circle of twice common diameter

name: Destructive Breath
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Cone

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range/size/damage; instantaneous cone attack. Level 7: even a successful Dodge/Anticipate requires Acrobatics; failure takes degree 1 remaining damage. Accelerated targets automatically pass. Level 10: remaining damage becomes degree 2 only when the attack itself had degree 2 or more.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Current
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Wave

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range, standard width/height and damage. Starts anywhere within range in any direction except upward. Targets test Vigor against standard DC−2 or are pushed to range end. Collision with an obstructing obstacle adds 1 bludgeoning damage. Level 8: failed resistance plus collision also stuns until the end of the target’s next turn; wave width may be narrowed to a minimum equal to used power level.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Missile
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Line to target

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range and damage; instantaneous. On a hit reroll the attack against the original defense; another success adds 1 base damage. Level 8: two extra tests. Level 10: four extra tests. Katon Fire Dragon variant: against a target bound with kousen in the same turn, use a partial action and destroy that wire.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Explosive Wave
description:
Action: Standard, optionally plus Move

Area / Target: Hemisphere or circle centered on user; twice common diameter

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common damage. Targets test Vigor against standard DC−2 or are pushed to the area’s edge. Adding a move action avoids the adjacent-enemy Ranged Combat−3 penalty; this mode receives no technique-aptitude benefits and cannot use Boost (Impulsionar). Level 8: failed resistance also knocks prone.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.
shape: Hemisphere or circle centered on user; twice common diameter

name: Shackle
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Single target

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range; concentration; no damage. Restrain one or both legs, immobilizing the target. Standard action to attack the bindings (standard Hardness) or escape with Strength/Escape versus standard DC. Other techniques that do not require leg mobility remain usable. Area attacks also damage the bindings. Level 8: sustained. Level 10: up to 3 targets within 5 m of each other; a second application to the same targets restrains the entire body, making them defenseless.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Project
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Single target; half common range

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common damage; instantaneous. On a hit target tests Vigor against common DC−2 or moves in a straight line in any chosen direction by the damage degree in meters, without falling prone. Level 7: cannot Block; movement is half common power size; a critical failed resistance knocks prone.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Repel
description:
Action: Move, reactive

Area / Target: Self or ally within common range

Chakra cost: Power level used

Only reactive against projectile techniques/weapons, touch techniques or strikes. Read Movement+1, paying before rolling; instantaneous standard Hardness absorbs the attack. If fully absorbed, everyone adjacent to the protection is moved 1 m backward; if broken, excess damage passes through and nobody moves. Adjacent enemies require Concentration. Level 7: subsequent uses until next turn are free actions at half chakra, with no adjacent-enemy Concentration test.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.
shape: Self or ally within common range

name: Blinding
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Single target; half common range

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common damage; on a hit victim suffers partial-camouflage penalties until cleaning their face or 3 turns pass. Clean with standard action automatically, or move action Strength/Dexterity against common DC. Level 8: total-camouflage penalties and 5 turn natural recovery.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Disaster
description:
Action: Concentration

Area / Target: Epicenter within 2×common range; area 3×common size

Chakra cost: 3×used power level

Damage 3×used level. Cannot substitute power level for Spirit when calculating size. Channel a natural disaster; while inside, everyone except user is Slowed and faces the user’s RCattack at their turn start; structures also suffer damage each turn. To spare someone, free-action Concentration against 2×used level+9 at their turn start. Lasts for the stated concentration duration; after concentration breaks it remains for one full round, without protection attempts. Once per scene, no technique aptitudes.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

Action: Full

Area / Target: Personal

Chakra cost: Power level used

Gain Expert:Stealth, cannot move, vision 10 m; attacking or using a technique originating from the user reveals position. Emerge with a move action. Element Hardness does not protect the body. False Decapitation: full action from successful underground Stealth to surprise Grapple a target directly above and leave its body underground, head exposed, impeded; move action Strength/Escape DC 10 to escape. Level 4: half-speed movement within the element and unimpaired senses.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Doton — Tremor
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Circle diameter 2 m

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range; instantaneous, no damage. Failed defense knocks prone; a target may immediately spend a move action for an Acrobatics check to stay standing. Level 4: area expands to the common power diameter.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

description:
Action: Move

Area / Target: Personal

Chakra cost: Power level used

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Doton — Vacuum Displacement
description:
Action: Partial

Area / Target: Willing target

Chakra cost: 2; level 7:3 total

Common range; one round. Reduce resistance or assist motion with the element: air for Fuuton, swimming in water for Suiton, sliding across ground for Doton. Target gains movement equal to half Spirit until their next turn begins. Level 7: up to 5 willing targets for one 3 chakra payment.

name: Suiton — Power Rules
description: Medium range 10 m+2 m/Spirit; size 1 m/Spirit. All ordinary Ninpou effects; also Immerse, Poisonous, Flammable and water-specific effects. General Ninpou rules apply unless this element says otherwise. Effects listed here are options to learn, not automatic grants. Ordinary level, attribute, aptitude and equipment prerequisites still apply.

name: Suiton — Cannon
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Single target

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common power range; instantaneous. Base damage 2 × power level used. From level 2, may use without chakra at half damage, including halved damage bonuses; this mode cannot combine benefits unless expressly allowed.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Create Weapon
description:
Action: Partial

Area / Target: Personal

Chakra cost: 1

No hand seals. Create simple/martial light, medium, long or throwing weapons, excluding Kage Fuuma, Straight Blade and Giant Fan. One use fills one equipment slot. Normal weapon prerequisites and proficiency still apply. Solid weapons are permanent; other weapons are sustained and vanish on leaving the hand. Gain elemental strengths/weaknesses and extra Hardness, but no elemental damage bonus. May Block projectile techniques. Level 6: heavy weapons and weapons for creatures larger than Medium.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Orb
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Single target

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range; instantaneous spherical projectile, diameter 0.5 m, standard power damage. Level 7: half chakra and cannot be Blocked, but receives no other effect, technique-aptitude or power benefits. This Advanced Guide revision supersedes the Basic Book Orb.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Ray / Beam
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: One or more targets

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range; instantaneous. Base damage 2 × power level. Cannot be Blocked except with a special weapon able to block techniques. Level 5: one ray per 2 power levels, one per target, targets at most 4 m apart. Level 8: full action for a stronger single-target ray with +2 base damage.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Restraint
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Circle

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range; continuous sticky/thick terrain slows creatures inside except those with Flight. Creatures already in the area get a defense; success still requires leaving on their next turn. Once per turn as a free action, Strength/Escape against standard DC suppresses Slowed until turn end; leaving prevents reapplication. Any area attack in the region removes the effect. Level 6: immobilized instead of slowed.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Barrier
description:
Action: Move

Area / Target: Wall or half-cylinder

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range; half common size and standard Hardness. Defensive Read Movement check at +2 accuracy, chakra paid before rolling. Cannot defend against an adjacent enemy where there is no room to place the barrier. Excess damage passes through a broken barrier; damaged unbroken objects lose 2 Hardness. Solid barriers permanent, others sustained. Level 6: hemispherical dome, or cage an enemy with standard action/Ranged Combat−2. Level 9: +2 Hardness.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Arrows
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: One or more targets

Chakra cost: Power level used; Feint 2

Common range; instantaneous. Create one projectile per used level, each with 2 base damage; concentrate or divide among targets. Each target defends once and gets damage bonuses only once. Feint mode deals no damage and uses Sleight of Hand instead of Agility to conceal the next ranged attack. Level 6: against one target that Dodges/Anticipates successfully, reroll attack against the same defense for half damage. Level 9: reroll damage is full.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Spear
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: One or more targets

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range and damage; instantaneous. A spike forms within 2 m and extends toward targets; divide damage among multiple targets. Ignore 3 Hardness of barriers/objects and 1 Body Hardness. Level 6: emerges below the target, ignores cover and prone defense bonuses, bypasses up to 2 Body Hardness. Level 9: target tests Readiness or becomes flat-footed; ignore all Hardness/Body Hardness. This Advanced Guide revision supersedes the Basic Book Spear.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Ricochet
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Chain of targets

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range and damage; instantaneous. Hit an initial target and up to one additional different target per 2 power levels, each within 10 m of the initial target. Choose order; the chain ends when any target defends successfully. Level 9: +1 base damage per new target hit, maximum+5.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Column
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Cylinder

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range and size; instantaneous; base damage 2 × used level. Level 7: divide the original area into 1 m-diameter columns, choosing affected locations within that original area. Level 10: these mini-columns force Readiness checks; failure weakens defense by−2.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Energize
description:
Action: Partial

Area / Target: Personal: limbs, weapon or projectile compartment

Chakra cost: 3

No hand seals; sustained. May replace weapon Strength/Dexterity damage attribute with Spirit. Weapon gains elemental advantages/weaknesses but not elemental damage/Hardness bonuses. Ambidexterity allows both weapons with one action but separate costs. Ends when a weapon is no longer wielded; launched projectiles expire at the end of the user’s turn. Allows Blocking projectile techniques and maneuver attacks. Can follow same-element Create Weapon as a free action. Cannot stack another melee-altering support technique or affect special weapons unless expressly allowed. Energized Iron Fist may use Spirit instead of Strength to determine its weapon damage, without Spirit bonuses.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.
shape: Personal: limbs, weapon or projectile compartment

name: Suiton — Cloud
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Cone settling into a circle of twice common diameter

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range; concentration. At each living creature’s turn start, Vigor versus standard DC−2; failure takes fixed damage equal to used level and Slowed. User is immune; no contact between turns means no effect that turn. Imaginary Hardness equals standard Hardness and is eroded by explosive/wind area attacks, but does not reduce attack damage. Level 7: sustained. Level 10: +3 imaginary Hardness and double fixed damage.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.
shape: Cone settling into a circle of twice common diameter

name: Suiton — Destructive Breath
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Cone

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range/size/damage; instantaneous cone attack. Level 7: even a successful Dodge/Anticipate requires Acrobatics; failure takes degree 1 remaining damage. Accelerated targets automatically pass. Level 10: remaining damage becomes degree 2 only when the attack itself had degree 2 or more.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Current
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Wave

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range, standard width/height and damage. Starts anywhere within range in any direction except upward. Targets test Vigor against standard DC−2 or are pushed to range end. Collision with an obstructing obstacle adds 1 bludgeoning damage. Level 8: failed resistance plus collision also stuns until the end of the target’s next turn; wave width may be narrowed to a minimum equal to used power level.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Missile
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Line to target

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range and damage; instantaneous. On a hit reroll the attack against the original defense; another success adds 1 base damage. Level 8: two extra tests. Level 10: four extra tests. Katon Fire Dragon variant: against a target bound with kousen in the same turn, use a partial action and destroy that wire.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Explosive Wave
description:
Action: Standard, optionally plus Move

Area / Target: Hemisphere or circle centered on user; twice common diameter

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common damage. Targets test Vigor against standard DC−2 or are pushed to the area’s edge. Adding a move action avoids the adjacent-enemy Ranged Combat−3 penalty; this mode receives no technique-aptitude benefits and cannot use Boost (Impulsionar). Level 8: failed resistance also knocks prone.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.
shape: Hemisphere or circle centered on user; twice common diameter

name: Suiton — Shackle
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Single target

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range; concentration; no damage. Restrain one or both legs, immobilizing the target. Standard action to attack the bindings (standard Hardness) or escape with Strength/Escape versus standard DC. Other techniques that do not require leg mobility remain usable. Area attacks also damage the bindings. Level 8: sustained. Level 10: up to 3 targets within 5 m of each other; a second application to the same targets restrains the entire body, making them defenseless.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Immerse
description:
Action: Full

Area / Target: Personal

Chakra cost: Power level used

Continuous. Merge into a sufficiently large natural element or Free Creation/Barrier of that element. Gain Expert:Stealth, cannot move, vision 10 m; attacking or using a technique originating from the user reveals position. Emerge with a move action. Element Hardness does not protect the body. False Decapitation: full action from successful underground Stealth to surprise Grapple a target directly above and leave its body underground, head exposed, impeded; move action Strength/Escape DC 10 to escape. Level 4: half-speed movement within the element and unimpaired senses.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Poisonous
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Cone

Chakra cost: Power level used plus a poison dose

Common range/size; instantaneous. Delivers a prepared poison of categoryIIor higher; no technique damage. On a hit the target makes the poison’s resistance tests. Consumes the poison dose; this effect does not grant poison crafting or restricted Dokujutsu.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.
chakraCost: Power level used plus a poison dose

name: Suiton — Flammable
description:
Action: Move or Standard, by mode

Area / Target: Circle

Chakra cost: 3 + ignition effect cost, or used power level by mode

Meta mode: create a flammable substance; a standard-action Katon/Raiton Cannon ignites it for that Cannon’s damage+2 in the area. No technique meta-aptitudes combine with Flammable. Continuous mode: create a hazardous region; a Katon/Raiton technique inside ignites it at its user for common damage and forces Concentration to avoid failing that technique; combustion ends the effect. Natural Sciences against common DC identifies the hazard as a free action. Level 8: meta mode accepts any instantaneous common-range Katon/Raiton effect; continuous mode may be triggered by any GM-approved spark, including metal clashes or firearm discharge.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.
chakraCost: 3 + ignition effect cost, or used power level by mode

name: Suiton — Mist
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Circle diameter 30 m+3 m per Spirit; common height

Chakra cost: Power level used

Requires Blind-Fight or sensor aptitude. Origin within 1 m; sustained. Sight is clear only within 1 m; beyond that partial camouflage. Imaginary Hardness equals common power Hardness and is eroded by explosive/wind area attacks; zero dissipates mist, and imaginary Hardness does not absorb attack damage. Wind has advantage against it, Earth does not. Level 5: partial camouflage within 1 m and total camouflage beyond 1 m. Optional Ninpou version requires GM permission and cannot evolve.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.
shape: Circle diameter30m+3m per Spirit; common height

name: Suiton — Water Prison
description:
Action: Standard; maintained by concentration

Area / Target: Single target within 1 m

Chakra cost: Power level used

MC touch or RC with proximity−3; remain in contact. Paralyzes without initially preventing speech/breathing. Half common Hardness; reuse action/chakra to restore it without a new attack. Water clones can each hold a target but original user still concentrates. Victim may spend a standard action on Strength against common DCor Vigor against DC−2 to gain mobility for the scene and attack the prison. A killing blow breaks the prison and loses that maneuver’s effect but any damage above Hardness still hits automatically with rolled degree. No meta-aptitudes. Level 9: suffocating prison, resistance DC−2; via Water Clone becomes sustained.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Wave Collision
description:
Action: Standard; concentration to maintain

Area / Target: Wave

Chakra cost: Power level used; half cost each maintained turn

Common range/size. Base damage 10; structures take double. Maintained waves catch targets that fail defense. At turn start they may use move+Athletics to surface or suffer suffocation with fixed damage equal to effect base; a standard action surfaces without a test. May instead hold breath with Vigor against common DC−2. Submerged victims cannot be targeted by outside physical attacks. May attack other targets again and move the wave within range, without affecting already submerged targets again. Level 8: base 14. Level 10: base 18 and no automatic standard-action surfacing.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.
chakraCost: Power level used; half cost each maintained turn

name: Suiton — Vacuum Displacement
description:
Action: Partial

Area / Target: Willing target

Chakra cost: 2; level 7:3 total

Common range; one round. Reduce resistance or assist motion with the element: air for Fuuton, swimming in water for Suiton, sliding across ground for Doton. Target gains movement equal to half Spirit until their next turn begins. Level 7: up to 5 willing targets for one 3 chakra payment.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Project
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Single target; half common range

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common damage; instantaneous. On a hit target tests Vigor against common DC−2 or moves in a straight line in any chosen direction by the damage degree in meters, without falling prone. Level 7: cannot Block; movement is half common power size; a critical failed resistance knocks prone.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Purify
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Environment: circle of common diameter

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common range; instantaneous. Remove impurities or dangerous substances from the element. Used level must exceed the generating effect’s level; versus poisons,2×used level must exceed producer Poisoncraft. Equal levels require Spirit against the substance’s DC, or generating power’s normal DC/GM-defined DCwhen none is specified. Mundane purification is adjudicated by the GM.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Repel
description:
Action: Move, reactive

Area / Target: Self or ally within common range

Chakra cost: Power level used

Only reactive against projectile techniques/weapons, touch techniques or strikes. Read Movement+1, paying before rolling; instantaneous standard Hardness absorbs the attack. If fully absorbed, everyone adjacent to the protection is moved 1 m backward; if broken, excess damage passes through and nobody moves. Adjacent enemies require Concentration. Level 7: subsequent uses until next turn are free actions at half chakra, with no adjacent-enemy Concentration test.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.
shape: Self or ally within common range

name: Suiton — Blinding
description:
Action: Standard

Area / Target: Single target; half common range

Chakra cost: Power level used

Common damage; on a hit victim suffers partial-camouflage penalties until cleaning their face or 3 turns pass. Clean with standard action automatically, or move action Strength/Dexterity against common DC. Level 8: total-camouflage penalties and 5 turn natural recovery.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Suiton — Disaster
description:
Action: Concentration

Area / Target: Epicenter within 2×common range; area 3×common size

Chakra cost: 3×used power level

Damage 3×used level. Cannot substitute power level for Spirit when calculating size. Channel a natural disaster; while inside, everyone except user is Slowed and faces the user’s RCattack at their turn start; structures also suffer damage each turn. To spare someone, free-action Concentration against 2×used level+9 at their turn start. Lasts for the stated concentration duration; after concentration breaks it remains for one full round, without protection attempts. Once per scene, no technique aptitudes.

Apply the selected power’s range, size, elemental advantages/weaknesses and damage/Hardness modifiers only where the effect permits them.

name: Mist — Optional Ninpou Rule
description: Requires explicit GM permission and Blind-Fight or a sensor aptitude. Use Suiton Mist’s level 2 rules without its later evolutions. Standard action; sustained; standard level-based chakra. Area diameter 30 m+3 m/Spirit, origin within 1 m. Partial camouflage beyond 1 m; imaginary Hardness follows the Mist rules. This option does not allow other elements to learn Mist.
